description: This file defines a PHP class 'SubTotal' which is a controller for handling the 'Subtotal' total extension in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for displaying the configuration page ('index') and saving settings ('save'), with logic for managing breadcrumbs, permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Controller class for the SubTotal total extension in OpenCart's admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the SubTotal extension, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the SubTotal extension, with permission checks and JSON response.
